title: Bob Ballard's search for Atlantis

tellings.quote: which they now say is up in the Red Sea. The Naval U has a consultant named Bob Ballard at the institute in Connecticut.

plain: The lost city of Atlantis is now said by some to lie in the Red Sea, and the ocean explorer Bob Ballard, a consultant to a navy school who works at an institute in Connecticut, has been involved in looking for it. John S. Herrington, the US Secretary of Energy, mentions this on the show as something he has heard, as part of a wider talk about hidden history.
